summary: ReserveAmerica confirms the 2027 season May 28 - Oct 10 (unchanged), reservable on ReserveAmerica, 1-night stays all season, phone 518-827-4711. Added 9-month window, 14-night max; no electric confirmed; 30 sites, max 35 ft (was 34, derived), one pull-through; showers confirmed, no dump station (new). Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of site/hookup/booking restatements.
flags: Minor: only 6 of the 30 sites are listed at 25 ft or more (2 at 35, 2 at 30, 2 at 25); 13 are listed at 10-20 ft and 11 have no length, so a 23-ft rig must pick its site.
